facts.activity_file: assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - work permit records incomplete for PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on PSV-4210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during routine operation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 22 May 2013 a planned field verification of PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch not effective.
